caption: The drawing depicts a single brown ceramic pitcher with a handle and a spout. The body of the pitcher is cylindrical and features a textured surface with raised decorations, including clusters of grapes and leaves on its side. The upper and lower edges of the pitcher are bordered with geometric zigzag patterns. The inside of the pitcher is a lighter color, appearing white or pale blue. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist's signature, "Carl Buegneriss," is visible in small, neat writing on the lower right side of the image.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
